spine: 1. 目標：把 wasm2js（Binaryen）vendor 進 Anubis，讓 PoW 驗證邏輯只在一處定義、client 與 server 兩端 byte-identical——前提是 wasm2js 自己可重現編譯。
2. 原始碼層：__DATE__/__TIME__ 把編譯時間印進 binary，同源連編兩次（Jun 18 2026 00:00:59 vs 00:01:11）就不同 byte。
3. 連結工具層：clang 連結時 shell out 到 $PATH 上的 wasm-opt；workstation v130、DGX Spark v108，舊版跟不上 WebAssembly Exceptions extension，arm64 build fail——修法 --no-wasm-opt。
4. codegen 層：clang exception handling 路徑有 address-sensitive codegen，raw pointer 洩進 try_table 順序，每個 build 差約 29 byte。
5. 修法兩步：setarch --addr-no-randomize 關 ASLR；x86_64 與 arm64 各自在可信任機器上建 known-good sha256。
6. 邊界：同架構內 deterministic，跨 host/架構仍不可重現——上游 LLVM 的問題，作者自陳無力處理。

perspective.mechanism: 可重現編譯的不確定性來自三個不同 toolchain 層級——原始碼宏（__DATE__/__TIME__）、連結器隱形 shell out（wasm-opt from $PATH）、codegen 對 raw pointer 敏感（exception handling 的 try_table 順序）；各層各有獨立修法。
perspective.tradeoff: 關 ASLR + 各架構各自 checksum 換到的是『同架構內可重現』，但放棄了跨架構可重現；後者根源在上游 LLVM，不在應用層可控範圍。
perspective.reader_use: 任何要 vendor binary、做供應鏈稽核或 reproducible build 的工程師，可照三層檢查清單排查：拔時間戳、切掉 toolchain 對 $PATH 的隱形依賴、build 時關 ASLR 並把可重現承諾限定在同架構內。

notes.quote: Part of the implementation goals of this work is that the check logic is defined in one place on both client and server.
notes.interpretation: 說明為何驗證邏輯要兩端共用、進而需要 byte-identical 的可重現產物。

notes.quote: In order to really make sure that the output of this is deterministic (essential for reproducible builds), I need to bundle a copy of wasm2js.
notes.interpretation: 可重現編譯是 bundle wasm2js 的硬前提；wasm2js 來自 Binaryen，是 C++ 工具。

notes.quote: There are a shocking number of ways to accidentally create nondeterministic output when doing C/C++ development.
notes.interpretation: 作者對 C/C++ 不確定性來源之多的總評，作為三層 debug 的開場。

notes.quote: One of the easiest is to use the builtin __DATE__ and __TIME__ macros to stamp a build with the time the compiler was executed at
notes.interpretation: 第一個不確定性來源在原始碼層：時間戳宏。例子顯示同源兩次編譯 Jun 18 2026 00:00:59 vs 00:01:11。

notes.quote: clang shells out to wasm-opt when doing builds.
notes.interpretation: clang 連結時自動呼叫 wasm-opt——一個隱形的外部依賴。

notes.quote: This normally makes sense, but in this case it caused builds to fail on my DGX Spark because its version of wasm-opt is too old
notes.interpretation: DGX Spark 上 wasm-opt 太舊導致 build fail；對照 workstation v130 vs DGX Spark v108。
workstation 上的 wasm-opt 版本。
DGX Spark 上的較舊 wasm-opt 版本，造成 arm64 build fail。

notes.quote: Turns out that wasi-sdk and binaryen rely on the WebAssembly Exceptions extension
notes.interpretation: 舊版 wasm-opt 跟不上的具體 extension：WebAssembly Exceptions；編 C++ 必然走到。

notes.quote: C++ is also one of the main places where exceptions are used.
notes.interpretation: 因為 wasm2js 是 C++，必然用到 exceptions，所以一定撞上 EH extension。

notes.quote: The solution was to pass --no-wasm-opt at the linking step. This removed one angle of irreproducibility.
notes.interpretation: wasm-opt 問題的修法是連結時 --no-wasm-opt；作者明說只移除了不可重現的『一個』角度，暗示還有別的。

notes.quote: The version of clang that I use to compile wasm2js has some address-sensitive code generation hiding in its exception handling path. Raw pointer values leak into the order a handful of try_table blocks come out in. This surfaces as every build differing from the next by about 29 bytes
notes.interpretation: 第三層、最深的不確定性：clang EH codegen 對位址敏感，raw pointer 洩進 try_table 排列順序，造成每個 build 差約 29 byte。

notes.quote: Disable address-space randomization for this build using setarch --addr-no-randomize.
notes.interpretation: 29 byte 漂移的修法第一步：用 setarch --addr-no-randomize 關 ASLR。

notes.quote: Create known good sha256 checksums for both x86_64 and arm64 via building this program on machines I trust.
notes.interpretation: 修法第二步：x86_64 與 arm64 各自在可信任機器上建 known-good sha256 checksum。

notes.quote: At the very least builds are deterministic within architectures. This may have to be good enough for now.
notes.interpretation: 結果的邊界：同架構內可重現；作者用 may / for now 的措辭承認這是暫時的妥協。

notes.quote: I'd really love to have this be reproducible across hosts, but that's an upstream LLVM bug that I am not powerful enough to tackle.
notes.interpretation: 跨 host 可重現的根源被定位在上游 LLVM bug，作者自陳無力處理。
